commitResults.messageBody: Use the course terminology for the class that owns and manages the task collection. Update Ari and Storage to use the new class and variable name.
Move scanner ownership, welcome text, message output, and divider formatting out of Ari. Keep Ari focused on interpreting commands and coordinating task operations without changing console behavior.
Record the required course standard for future changes and wrap Ui help text within the 120-character limit without changing its output.

commitResults.messageTitle: Encapsulate the task file path in Storage
commitResults.messageBody: Construct Storage with its data file path and convert its operations from static methods to instance methods. This makes each Storage object responsible for its own file.

commitResults.messageTitle: Separate storage operations from user messages
commitResults.messageBody: Let Storage report file outcomes through return values and exceptions. Route loading and saving messages through Ui so Storage deals only with persistence.
Give Ari private Ui, Storage, and TaskList fields plus a constructor and run method. Keep startup and saving helpers focused while main only creates and runs the app.

Keep src/main/java as the source root while grouping UI, storage, task, and exception classes under the ari package. Update imports, recursive test compilation, the fully qualified launch class, and README paths.

commitResults.messageBody:
The private deadline helper assumes its callers supply non-null
 descriptions and deadline text, but these assumptions are implicit.

Add assertions to document the contract between methods and help
locate programming mistakes during development.

commitResults.messageTitle: DeadlineTask: Check the single deadline representation
commitResults.messageBody:
A deadline must contain either a parsed date or free-form text, but
not both. Displaying or saving an invalid state can hide a bug.

Assert that exactly one representation exists before displaying or
saving a deadline. Report invalid states with AssertionError when
assertions are enabled.

commitResults.messageTitle: Enable assertions in development and test runs
commitResults.messageBody:
Assertions only detect programming mistakes when the runtime enables
them. Development and test entry points should check the same assumptions.

Enable assertions for Gradle run, JUnit and the console test runner.
Add four tests covering assertion activation, invalid deadline states
and valid display and storage formatting.

commitResults.messageBody:

commitResults.messageTitle: Protect task data with transactional autosave
commitResults.messageBody:
Stage mutations on independent copies and atomically replace the file before publishing changes. Reject failed saves and protect data after failed loads instead of overwriting it on exit.

Validate command arity, separators and ISO dates. Handle unknown commands and EOF safely. Add deterministic regression tests and update console expectations.
Protect task data with transactional autosave

commitResults.messageBody: Check every mutation is saved before exit, independent copies preserve task representations, and Unicode plus locale-sensitive parsing remain stable. Cover malformed records, calendar boundaries and protected startup failures with isolated data.
